title: 🔥宏观风险压制盘面
body: 市场处于宏观风险规避阶段。BMRI报75，处于RISK_OFF状态，确认当前流动性环境依然紧绷。BTC近7日下跌2.9%，显示资金在博弈降息前仍保持谨慎。若油价下跌重燃宽松预期，将是打破当前震荡的关键变量。当前定价权完全掌握在宏观手中。偏中性。宏观拐点何时出现？
body_en: The market is in a macro risk-aversion phase. BMRI is at 75, signaling RISK_OFF and confirming that the liquidity environment remains tight. BTC has dropped 2.9% over the last 7 days, indicating capital is still cautious as it plays the rate cut game. If falling oil prices reignite easing expectations, that will be the key variable to break this current consolidation. Right now, pricing power is entirely in the hands of macro. Leaning neutral. When will the macro inflection point arrive?
